cloud.mix_create.label: Make a mix in the Cloud
cloud.mix_create.about: Create and edit planned mixes from Cloud Library songs, using the same mix contract as the local app. Seams are plain crossfades until songs have tempo and key facts.

cloud.single_audio_owner.label: One Cloud player
cloud.single_audio_owner.about: Cloud Library previews and Cloud Listen play through one persistent player that keeps playing across pages.

cloud.account_states.label: Clear Cloud account states
cloud.account_states.about: Exact Cloud routes and distinct messages for signed-out, expired, suspended and unreachable accounts.

cloud.library_states.label: Truthful Cloud Library states
cloud.library_states.about: Tell loading, failed, empty and ready apart, and report each uploaded file's own result.

rooms.nickname_confirm.label: Confirmed guest nicknames
rooms.nickname_confirm.about: Show a guest's nickname as saving, saved or not saved, and ignore older Room updates that arrive late.

mixes.intent_language.label: Plain Make a mix choices
mixes.intent_language.about: Separate quick listen from a saved mix and say how long each setting lasts and what it applies to.

autopilot.venue_mode.label: Autopilot venue mode
autopilot.venue_mode.about: Night sessions for a venue with defined autonomy levels, and pause, stop and manual takeover always available.

autopilot.venue_policy.label: Venue music identity
autopilot.venue_policy.about: Versioned venue music policies, schedules, hard limits and timed overrides for Autopilot.

autopilot.horizon.label: Rolling musical horizon
autopilot.horizon.about: Plan the next stretch of the evening ahead, rank songs deterministically and replan only at safe points.

autopilot.safe_transitions.label: Conservative Autopilot transitions
autopilot.safe_transitions.about: Check every transition before it plays and fall back to simpler, safer blends when a check fails.

autopilot.ai_director.label: AI DJ director
autopilot.ai_director.about: Let an AI suggest typed, bounded changes to the Autopilot plan that staff can inspect and undo.
